supplemental_inspection.reason: Requested independent inspection of the metadata-reported diagram failure; this item is outside lane-03 assignment coverage.
supplemental_inspection.visible_evidence: The original tile shows a red “diagram failed to render” block containing raw TikZ-cd source in place of the associator pentagon. Surrounding prose and equations remain legible; the diagram itself cannot be visually checked.

findings.evidence: Individually opened originals show the S-colored definition equations beginning in tile 01 rendered as raw TeX, with following prose/equations red and unformatted; tile 02 continues the raw TeX/error cascade. The “Diagram convention” TikZ source at lines 140–143 is displayed as literal code and no diagram appears. Metadata lists 11 KaTeX errors and tikz_count 0, but this finding is based on the visible originals.
findings.limitation: The intended uncolored Frobenius equality is typed in source as A⊗A→A⊗A on both sides; because the TikZ fence is not rendered, arrow placement/labels cannot be inspected from the tile.

existing_diagram_checks.evidence: Tile 02 displays two exact rows 0→W→U→U/W→0 and 0→W→L→L/W→0. The vertical maps are W=id, U↪L, and the induced U/W↪L/W. Source arrows use hook for subobjects and two-head for quotients; indexing and orientations are consistent with the statement.

The uncolored equality Δ∘μ=(1⊗μ)∘α∘(Δ⊗1) has source and target A⊗A in lines 136–143. Intended arrow labels match that typed equation; original tile displays literal TikZ source instead of the diagram.

The original standalone tile visibly shows the raw diagram-failure block; metadata failure is corroborating information, not the basis of the report. No visual conclusion is made about whether all arrow placements in the unavailable diagram are rendered correctly.

diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The claim is supported by a long proof whose central bookkeeping identifies a product exterior, three boundary tori, actual meridian/longitude curves, and two filling slopes before cutting and regluing a compression body. A small schematic could make those geometric identifications auditable; the source already gives the mathematical data and explicitly explains the product without relying on a diagram.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Draw P as a disk with two interior disks, label boundary components T_A,T_K,T_U and fiber h; mark b_A,b_K,b_U and the slope identifications μ_K=h, λ_K=b_K, μ_U=b_U, λ_U=h. Show fillings along b_K+fh and h; optionally a second panel shows α×S¹ capped in V to give proper disk D with ∂D=h⊂T_A, and the resulting T²×I plus h-meridian 2-handle. Keep orientations and framing sign f explicit.
